system.description:
This narrow vessel is the Burning Barge. The corridors of the hedge maze are narrow and overgrown. The thick walls of evergreen hedge reach high above the heads of those inside, and thorny stems of bramble protrude at all angles. A character on the Burning Barge for a very unpleasant environment. During his End of Turn step suffers 1 fatigue. If that character is fatigued, he suffers 1 wound instead. All physical actions in the Hedge Maze gain: Filthy condition.

While in the Realm of Tzeentch, the air is filled with faint music and perfumes, strange thronging about enthusiastically. While in the Realm of Khorne, the foetid air is alive with mosquitoes and biting flies. Add 1 to the dice pools of all characters of the brass social tier and 1 to the dice pools of all characters of the gold social tier. Add 1 to the dice pools of all Channelling, Magical Discipline (WP) checks, Sight, and Spellcraft checks. In addition, all Spellcraft checks gain: 1 to the dice pools of all non-Slaanesh characters. In the Inn Room due to the low ceiling and close quarters, all physical action checks made while in the Inn Room due to the low ceiling and close quarters. 88 Add 1 to the results pool of all actions made in the Realm of Slaanesh by non-Slaanesh characters. The Equilibrium score of a spellcaster in the Realm of Slaanesh is reduced by 1. REALM OF NURGLE: The air here is foetid and foul. Skulls and bones litter the ground, and bloated flies buzz lazily in huge piles. The wharf is busy with a confusion of small boats and larger barges tying, pulling, unloading, and loading. The ground is soiled with pools of pus and ichor. This impression is heightened by the daubed symbols of Khorne on some skulls in blood. Men, women, and a small number of dwarfs are hard at work, yelling at one another, carrying things, selling things, loafing, thieving, and bustling about the river. In addition, all actions on the wharf gain: 1 to the dice pools of all actions involving movement and Agility. In the Realm of Nurgle, if a character is wounded while on the wharf, he must make a Willpower check. If the check fails, the character contracts a disease with either the Wound or Filth trait. REALM OF TZEENTCH: Depending on the price and location, the restless, vital force that you can feel in your bones. The shapes of the landscape look wrong somehow, and the bushes and trees hang with the most tempting fruit, and the creatures here are the most beautiful you have ever seen. Add 1 to the dice pools of all Channelling, Magical Discipline (WP) checks, Sight, and Spellcraft checks. In addition, all Spellcraft checks gain: 1 to the dice pools of all non-Slaanesh characters. In the Realm of Tzeentch, you gain the Perplexed, Overwhelmed, or Sluggish condition (GM choice) for 2 rounds.
